evidence.title: WebMD Ignite Launches Healthcare Ads Offering For ChatGPT
evidence.body: [e005:f01] [Image 1: Google Preferred Source](https:// WebMD Ignite, the healthcare enterprise division of WebMD, has launched an offering to place ads in ChatGPT after OpenAI eased some restrictions on healthcare advertising in the United States. [e005:f02] OpenAI initially said in January that [ChatGPT ads would not appear](https:// near sensitive or regulated topics, including health, mental health and politics. [e005:f03] Its newer policy allows some less regulated healthcare ads on a case-by-case basis in the United States. [e005:f04] Health-related ads remain generally prohibited outside the United States, OpenAI’s policy says. [e005:f05] Ads for regulated products and services, and claims involving the prevention, diagnosis or treatment of physical or mental health conditions, also remain prohibited. ### Stay Ahead of the Curve! [e005:f06] OpenAI may accept ads for hospitals, urgent care, health insurance, dietary supplements, consumer medical devices, wearables and apps. [e005:f07] WebMD Ignite said OpenAI has so far permitted ads from health systems and providers, including hospitals and academic medical centers, but not insurance companies. [e005:f08] More than 30% of Americans have used AI chatbots for health advice or information, WebMD Ignite President Ann Bilyew said. [e005:f09] Medical providers want to be “present and discoverable” in large language models, she said. [e005:f10] WebMD Ignite works directly with OpenAI and applies lessons from one health-system client to others, she added. [e005:f11] ChatGPT’s current ad format is limited to an image, [brand name and short message](https:// said Nora Simmons, WebMD Ignite’s vice president of activation strategy. [e005:f12] Ads must be informational rather than promotional, Bilyew said. [e005:f13] Informational ads can include examples of services, locations, certifications and awards. [e005:f14] OpenAI said ads will not run when a health condition is strongly implied, even if a user does not state a diagnosis or request treatment directly. [e005:f15] WebMD Ignite is optimizing ads for informational searches that do not directly refer to a user’s own health condition, such as a request to understand heart health. [e005:f16] WebMD Ignite does not yet know the appropriate regional budgets or the available delivery and inventory, Bilyew said.

evidence.title: VP vs. VNP: Anthropic and OpenAI Announce AI Proof
evidence.body: [e002:f01] November 2026 · 4 min. read Anthropic and OpenAI published AI-generated proofs for a 47-year-old problem in theoretical computer science on the same day. [e002:f02] Both papers conclude that the complexity classes VP and VNP are distinct. [e002:f03] VNP question was posed by computer scientist Leslie Valiant in 1979; it is considered the algebraic counterpart to the famous P-NP problem. [e002:f04] CONTENTS i Key Points at a Glance On November 23, 2026, Anthropic and OpenAI each published a proof that VP ≠ VNP According to the repository, Anthropic’s work originated entirely from an internal Claude research model Both proofs are also available in formal form in the proof language Lean 4 A review by human experts is still pending The P-NP problem has therefore not been solved What VP vs. [e002:f05] In 1979, Valiant conjectured that VP and VNP are not equal. [e002:f06] What Anthropic Published Anthropic published its proof in a GitHub repository without much fanfare. [e002:f07] It follows that VP and VNP are distinct. [e002:f08] Anthropic did not specify the model itself in greater detail. [e002:f09] Anthropic itself is cautious about this: According to the repository, AI models wrote both the paper and the formal proof, and no human mathematician has verified the proof. [e002:f10] OpenAI follows suit a few hours later Just a few hours after Anthropic, OpenAI published its own paper on GitHub, also featuring a Lean-4 formalization and titled “VP and VNP are different.” According to initial assessments, the approaches differ in several respects. [e002:f11] It is not yet known which model OpenAI used. [e002:f12] Google is also driving the use of AI in mathematics and research forward with models such as Gemini 3 Deep Think . [e002:f13] According to his initial comments, computer scientist Lance Fortnow considers the result likely correct and a major achievement. [e002:f14] VNP, Anthropic and OpenAI have tackled a 47-year-old problem and both have presented a proof. [e002:f15] The formalization in Lean 4 makes the work significantly more verifiable than traditional papers. evidence.title: AnthropicとOpenAI、47年前の数学問題についてそれぞれ証明を発表
evidence.body: [e004:f01] * VP対VNP問題は、数学者レスリー・ヴァリアントが1979に提起した。 [e004:f02] AnthropicとOpenAIは同じ日にGitHubでこの問題を扱う論文を公開し、アップロード時刻によると、Anthropicの論文はOpenAIより約6時間早く公開された。 [e004:f03] 情報源： Notebookcheck . [e004:f04] Anthropicは、VNPがVPに含まれないことを示す証明を報告した。 [e004:f05] この研究は、同社のClaude AIモデルの社内研究版が行い、付随する論文と証明の形式検証も作成した。 [e004:f06] Anthropicによると、数学者による検証はまだ行われていなかった。 [e004:f07] OpenAIの論文も同じ問題を扱い、Lean 4による形式化も含んでいた。 [e004:f08] 両社による2つの証明は、いくつかの重要な点で異なる。 [e004:f09] 形式的な証明によって論理的な手順を検証できるが、数学的な主張には依然として独立した精査が必要だ。 [e004:f10] 問題をすばやく解けると示すよりも難しいのは、十分に効率的なアルゴリズムが存在しないことを証明しなければならないためだ。 [e004:f11] PとNPが等しいという証明は、コンピューティング、最適化、暗号技術など、さまざまな分野に大きな影響を及ぼす。 [e004:f12] また、数学界が証明を研究し、その手法をどこまで応用できるかを評価するには、さらに時間が必要だとも語った。 [e004:f13] 今回の発表に先立ち、リーマン予想の証明が報告されるなど、AIが関わる大きな数学的進展が最近ほかにも主張されている。 [e004:f14] こちらもおすすめです： Anthropicは重要インフラのサイバー防御を強化する新たな取り組みを開始し、パートナー企業に高性能なAIモデルや技術支援を提供します。 [e004:f15] OpenAIを解雇された安全研究者3人が、機密情報の不適切な取り扱いを否定。 [e004:f16] 解雇の経緯が、AIのリスクを議論する環境や独立した監視に及ぼす影響を懸念している。

[e002:f04] “SB Energy and OpenAI’s initial investment in workforce development strengthens our local education and training partners that know our region and can help our residents build bright careers here.” The investments reflect priorities identified through open houses, listening sessions and meetings with educators, labor organizations, employers and residents. evidence.title: SoftBank CDS Tops 516bp as AI Investment Skepticism Lifts Credit Risk to 4-Year High
evidence.body: [e003:f01] SoftBank's five-year CDS premium has surged to 516bp, the highest level since October 2022. [e003:f02] Growing skepticism over the profitability of AI infrastructure investments is fueling concerns about SoftBank's ability to service its debt, given the $64.6 billion it has poured into OpenAI. [e003:f03] Third-quarter financial costs rose 2.6-fold year-on-year to ¥461.9 billion (approximately $2.9 billion), and S&P said SoftBank's LTV has exceeded 30%, approaching the 35% threshold that triggers a downgrade review. [e003:f04] The CDS rise is expected to raise future refinancing and new funding costs. [e003:f05] SoftBank's five-year credit default swap (CDS) premium has topped 500bp for the first time in four years. [e003:f06] The move reflects financial-market concerns about the debt-servicing capacity of SoftBank, which has made large-scale AI investments, as doubts grow over the profitability of artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure spending. [e003:f07] According to Bloomberg data compiled on the 26th, SoftBank's five-year CDS climbed to 516bp, the highest level since October 2022. [e003:f08] A CDS is an insurance-like derivative that protects against bond default, and its price rises as the issuer's default risk increases. [e003:f09] SoftBank shares, by contrast, rose 9.2% to ¥2,945 (approximately $19) that day, putting the equity performance at odds with the warning signal from credit markets. [e003:f10] The market is questioning OpenAI's future valuation and SoftBank's ability to recoup its investment. [e003:f11] In September, SoftBank issued dollar-denominated bonds with a 9.75% coupon, the highest yield ever for a group dollar bond. [e003:f12] S&P Global Ratings said this month that SoftBank's key financial metrics are approaching the limits for maintaining its current credit rating. [e003:f13] S&P estimated SoftBank's loan-to-value (LTV) ratio has exceeded 30%, closing in on the 35% threshold that triggers a downgrade review. [e003:f14] Masahito Sugawara, chief strategist at Daiwa Securities, said, "The spread of AI businesses will not change, but monetization will take longer." He added that for AI companies that must repay debt with future cash flows, delayed monetization makes refinancing difficult and "could lead investors to demand higher spreads." The situation is expected to weigh on the funding structures of companies that have relied on AI infrastructure investment. [e003:f15] If credit spreads continue to widen, SoftBank's corporate bond issuance conditions will deteriorate, potentially shrinking its capacity for further AI investment. [e003:f16] For bond investors, this is a phase in which they must watch both the risk of valuation losses on their holdings and changes in the issuer's financial health.

evidence.title: AIで高度化するサイバー攻撃にAIで対抗 ソフトバンクとOpenAIの合弁会社が「侵入可否診断」を提供開始
evidence.body: [e004:f01] ソフトバンクグループとOpenAIの合弁会社であるSB OAI Japanは2026年11月25日、AIを活用したサイバーセキュリティ対策サービス「Patching as a Service」（PaaS）の新メニューとして「侵入可否診断」の提供を開始した。 [e004:f02] 企業がインターネット上に公開しているウェブアプリケーションやAPI、VPN装置などを対象に、OpenAIのサイバーセキュリティ技術を活用して想定される侵入経路を分析し、外部からのアクセスを試みることで、初期侵入の可能性を検証する。 [e004:f03] ■診断開始から10営業日以内に結果と対策案を提供 サービスの申し込み後、SB OAI Japanは企業の情報や診断対象を確認し、確認メールを送付する。 [e004:f04] 今回の「侵入可否診断」では、企業が指定したIPアドレスやURLを基に、外部から取得可能な情報や関連する脆弱性情報を調査。 [e004:f05] OpenAIのサイバーセキュリティ技術を活用して、攻撃者が利用する可能性のある侵入経路を検討する。 [e004:f06] その上で、アクセス頻度を制限するなど、稼働中のシステムへの影響を抑えながら外部からアクセスを試み、初期侵入が可能かどうかを検証する。 [e004:f07] システムに脆弱性や設定の不備が存在することを把握するだけでなく、それらが実際の侵入につながる可能性を検証できる点が特長だ。 [e004:f08] 企業は診断結果を基に、必要なセキュリティ対策や、より詳細な診断の必要性を判断することができる。 [e004:f09] ■AIによってサイバー攻撃も高度化 防御側もAIを活用 サービス提供の背景には、国内で相次ぐサイバー攻撃による情報漏えいと、AIによる攻撃の効率化がある。 [e004:f10] 個人情報保護委員会によると、2026年4月1日から10月16日までに報告された不正アクセスによる個人データの漏えいなどの事案で、対象となった人数は延べ約2億6,000万人に上る（速報値、漏えいなどの恐れがある事案を含む）。 [e004:f11] また、情報通信研究機構（NICT）は2026年10月、一般に公開されているAndroidアプリの解析を通じて、その接続先であるサーバーを狙う攻撃手法を、国内の情報漏えい事案の原因の一つとして特定した。 [e004:f12] AIの活用によって脆弱性の探索が効率化され、こうした攻撃がさらに広がる可能性も指摘している。 [e004:f13] AIは企業の業務効率化や生産性向上に貢献する一方で、サイバー攻撃者にも利用される。 [e004:f14] 企業が確認メールに返信した日の2営業日後から診断を開始し、10営業日以内に診断結果とリスクへの対策案をまとめたレポートを提供する。 [e004:f15] また、診断で侵入が確認されなかった場合でも、すべての侵入経路の安全性や将来のサイバー攻撃に対する安全性を保証するものではない。 [e004:f16] SB OAI Japanは今後も、AIを活用した脆弱性診断と修復支援を通じて、企業の事業・業務の継続を支援していく方針だ。

evidence.title: F1 Today: Williams hit by FIA cost cap penalty as Alonso raises Honda concerns and Verstappen renews Russell feud
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Wednesday's Formula 1 headlines focus on the FIA's financial regulations, Aston Martin's ongoing struggles with Honda, and the growing tension between Max Verstappen and George Russell ahead of the Qatar Grand Prix News Summary Williams faces financial and sporting penalties after exceeding the 2025 cost cap, while Alpine is also sanctioned for a reporting breach. [e001:f05] The FIA classified the case as a minor overspend accompanied by a procedural breach. [e001:f09] Despite the concerns, Alonso sees potential for improvement through chassis development and hopes the team can make progress ahead of the 2027 season. evidence.body: [e003:f01] The 28 Year Old was poured in Las Vegas alongside the second release of the partnership’s 16-year-old single malt, an $80 bottle that is on sale now, and the distillery also released a new 1977 vintage, a 48-year-old whisky drawn from a single cask. [e003:f02] It is the deepest lineup the Glenfiddich and Aston Martin partnership has produced since it was announced in 2024, and it runs from an everyday-priced limited edition to a single-cask whisky older than most of the drivers on the grid. [e003:f03] The headline bottle, though, is the 28 Year Old, and its construction is unlike anything else in the partnership so far. ## The Glenfiddich 28 Year Old: Two Cask Streams, One Virgin Oak Finish The 28 Year Old combines two distinct streams of whisky. [e003:f04] “Drawing on my understanding of Aston Martin’s character and design ethos, the result is a single malt that reflects our shared pursuit of refinement, while remaining unmistakably rooted in Glenfiddich’s 139-year legacy of whisky making.” The bottling strength backs up the intent. [e003:f05] The 28 Year Old is bottled at 87.4 proof, a step above the 86 proof of the partnership’s 16-year-old releases, and on the palate it shows a rich toasted oak note from the virgin oak finish, mingling with dried cranberry, dark chocolate and cinnamon spice. [e003:f06] It goes on sale in the United States in January at an SRP of $900, which positions it as a serious collector bottle without reaching the five-figure territory of the partnership’s oldest releases. ## Glenfiddich x Aston Martin Formula One: The Key Facts * **Headline release:** Glenfiddich 28 Year Old single malt, created by malt master Brian Kinsman * **Construction:** Ex-bourbon barrel whisky finished in virgin American oak, combined with whisky aged entirely in European ex-sherry hogsheads * **Proof:** 87.4 proof * **Tasting notes:** Rich toasted oak, dried cranberry, dark chocolate, cinnamon spice * **Price and availability:** SRP $900, on sale in the United States in January * **Companion release:** Glenfiddich & Aston Martin Formula One Team 16-Year-Old Limited-Edition Release No. [e003:f07] 2, SRP $80, on sale now * **Also released:** A 1977 vintage, 48 years old, from cask 24/6431-1, bottled at 51.3 percent ABV; no price was announced for the 1977 vintage * **Revealed:** Las Vegas, during the Formula 1 Grand Prix weekend ## The 1977 Vintage: 48 Years Old From a Single Cask The quietest announcement of the weekend may be the most extreme bottle in it. [e003:f08] Glenfiddich also released a new 1977 vintage under the Aston Martin partnership, a 48-year-old single malt taken from cask 24/6431-1 and bottled at 51.3 percent ABV. [e003:f09] One detail needs to be stated plainly: the announcement carries no price for the 1977 vintage. [e003:f10] Glenfiddich published suggested prices for the 28 Year Old and the 16 Year Old, but the single-cask 1977 was released without an announced figure, and any number attached to it elsewhere is not coming from the distillery’s release information. [e003:f11] Bottles of this age and scarcity tend to move through allocation rather than open shelves in any case, and the 1977 sits at the very top of a partnership ladder that now has a rung for nearly every level of collector. ## The $80 Bottle: 16-Year-Old Limited-Edition Release No. [e003:f12] Both versions of the 16-year-old were poured side by side in Las Vegas, and the second release came out ahead, with a wider range of flavors than the original: dried fruit, citrus, gentle spice and vanilla toffee. [e003:f13] Five cask types, running from first-fill bourbon to port pipes to two different styles of sherry wood, give the blender more distinct flavor threads to weave together than a three-cask construction can, and at $80 the result is the most accessible bottle the partnership has made. ## How the Partnership Got Here: From a 65-Year-Old 1959 to an $80 Everyday Bottle Glenfiddich and Aston Martin first announced their partnership in 2024, and they marked it the way luxury partnerships usually do, with a bottle almost nobody could buy: a 1959 vintage single malt, aged for 65 years in a sherry butt. [e003:f14] The strategy widened the following year, when the distillery launched the first 16-year-old single malt under the partnership, aged in three types of casks, American oak wine casks, new American oak and second-fill bourbon barrels, and bottled at 86 proof. [e003:f15] Earlier this year came Release No. [e003:f16] The 28 Year Old now extends the ladder upward, and the 1977 vintage caps it, which means the partnership that began with a single 65-year-old trophy bottle now spans from $80 to unpriced single-cask territory in three years.

evidence.title: Oliver Bearman to remain with Haas for 2027 F1 season after new contract finally agreed ahead of Qatar GP
evidence.body: [e004:f01] Oliver Bearman has signed a one-year contract extension to remain with Haas for the 2027 F1 season; watch the Qatar GP on Sky Sports F1 this weekend, with qualifying at 6pm on Saturday and the race at 4pm on Sunday Haas have confirmed Oliver Bearman will stay at the team for the 2027 Formula 1 season, after protracted contract talks resulted in a one-year extension. [e004:f02] Despite both the British driver and American-owned team having repeatedly insisted they wanted to continue together, negotiations had dragged on for several months, leading to speculation that his links to Ferrari - who he remains tied to after coming through their academy - were a factor in the delay. [e004:f03] The 21-year-old said ahead of last weekend's Las Vegas Grand Prix that he was "disappointed" a resolution had not been found, but the wait for confirmation was finally ended by Haas on Thursday ahead of this weekend's Qatar Grand Prix. [e004:f04] Latest Sky Sports deals or stream F1 with no contract 📺 "It's no secret that I'm delighted to be continuing with TGR Haas F1 Team into 2027," Bearman said. [e004:f05] "We've got big ambitions to keep pushing forward, and I'm excited to lead that work, building on what we've achieved, and striving for even more together - we have unfinished business." Bearman completes Haas' 2027 line-up, with Brazilian rookie Rafael Camara having last month been confirmed as Esteban Ocon's replacement. [e004:f06] Ocon was meant to see out the 2026 season but a fall out between the Frenchman and the team saw him replaced by reserve driver Ryo Hirakawa in Mexico, before Camara was given the final four races of the season to prepare for his full debut campaign. [e004:f07] Confirmation of Bearman's new deal also completes the 2027 Formula grid, with all 11 teams having now confirmed both of their drivers for next year. [e004:f08] Haas team principal Ayao Komatsu said: "Continuing with Ollie into 2027 was a natural decision for us. [e004:f09] Bearman has been affiliated to Ferrari since joining the Scuderia's driver academy as a 16-year-old in 2021, with those ties to the Italian team continuing during his time at Haas. [e004:f10] The Briton has made no secret of the fact that he considers racing for Ferrari in future as "the dream" but, for now, that path to F1's most-famous team is blocked with Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton staying in tandem next year - and potentially beyond. [e004:f11] Leclerc extended his deal with the team earlier this year for an undisclosed multi-year term, while Hamilton is understood to have a potential option to remain with the Italian squad into 2028. [e004:f12] Depending on whether Ferrari's line-up remains unchanged or not for 2028, and what that would mean for Bearman's overarching contractual situation with the Scuderia, his one-year Haas renewal potentially gives him flexibility to move up the grid somewhere should his strong form continue. [e004:f13] Speaking at United States Grand Prix in October, Bearman said: "I also feel like I'm ready to fight for podiums and fight at the front. [e004:f14] "In terms of a midfield team, Haas is the team that I want to be with and I see my future with. [e004:f15] But at some point as well, I feel like I've earned the opportunity to go out and look for a top-four team. [e004:f16] "And of course, with my link with Ferrari, that would be my ultimate goal." evidence.title: 「ナンバー1条項はない」ルクレール、契約内容にも言及。憶測を否定しフェラーリへの誠意を語る／F1第21戦水曜会見
evidence.body: [e005:f01] 憶測を否定しフェラーリへの誠意を語る／F1第21戦水曜会見 11/27(金) 12:00 配信 2026年F1第22戦カタールGP FIA会見 シャルル・ルクレール（フェラーリ）（XPB Images） 2026年F1第22戦カタールGPのFIAドライバー会見のパート1には、オリバー・ベアマン（ハース）、アイザック・ハジャー（レッドブル）、ジョージ・ラッセル（メルセデス）が出席した。 [e005:f02] ベアマンはこの会見の直前に、ようやくハースとの契約延長が発表されたばかりだ。 [e005:f03] 【写真】2026年F1第22戦カタールGP FIA会見 オリバー・ベアマン（ハース） Q：オリー、ハース残留が正式に決まりました。 [e005:f04] その時期のマシンは非常に強力で、しっかりポイントを獲得して、積み重ねることができた。 [e005:f05] Q：ラスベガスGPは望んでいた結果にはなりませんでしたが、序盤のペースは驚くほど素晴らしいものでした。 [e005:f06] 僕のF1キャリアで、初めてだったからね。 [e005:f07] シーズン終盤に何としても大きな結果を残したい、印象に残るレースをしたいと思って、リスクを取りすぎたのかもしれない。 [e005:f08] ■「自分の責任を認める」ハミルトンとの同士討ちを反省するルクレール ラスベガスGPでは、フェラーリのふたりがまたも同士討ちをやらかした。 [e005:f09] 会見のパート2に出席したシャルル・ルクレールには、フレデリック・バスール代表からの非難から質問は始まった。 [e005:f10] 少し多すぎるのは確かだね」 ルクレールに対しては最近、ハミルトンにはない優遇条項をフェラーリと結んでいるのではという憶測が飛んでいた。 [e005:f11] Q：フェラーリとの契約にナンバー1待遇が盛り込まれているという話が、ソーシャルメディア上で広がっています。 [e005:f12] ルクレール：「僕は普段、自分の契約内容を明かすことは決してない。 [e005:f13] 僕の契約に、ナンバー1条項はまったくない。 [e005:f14] 僕は2019年からフェラーリにいる。 [e005:f15] そして、フェラーリを再びトップに戻すためなら、僕は何でもするつもりだ。 [e005:f16] 今は決して楽しい時期ではないけれど、これもこの世界の一部だし、受け入れなければならないね」 フェラーリとの契約内容をあえて明らかにしてまで、ルクレールは誤解を解くのに必死だった。

evidence.title: フェラーリF1 ルクレールの契約にハミルトンにはない「ナンバー1条項」との報道
evidence.body: [e008:f01] 一方、ルイス・ハミルトンはF1キャリアを通じて、そうした契約上の保証を求めたことがないという。 [e008:f02] F1ラスベガスGPで再び接触した両ドライバーを巡り、フェラーリ内部の序列に注目が集まるなか、英国人ジャーナリストのレベッカ・クランシーが両者の契約に対する考え方の違いを指摘。 [e008:f03] ハミルトンが過去の所属チームと同様に、フェラーリでも主導権を握りつつあるとの見解を示した。 [e008:f04] ルクレールは契約でナンバー1の地位を要求か フェラーリF1のフレデリック・バスール代表はこれまで、ドライバー個人の利益よりもチームの利益を優先する必要性を繰り返し強調してきた。 [e008:f05] しかし、ルクレールの契約を巡る新たな情報は、バスールが直面している両ドライバーの管理という問題に、別の視点を加えるものとなりそうだ。 [e008:f06] BBCのF1ポッドキャストに出演したクランシーは、ルクレールがフェラーリ内部での自身の立場を守るため、特別な条項を契約に盛り込むことを求めたと指摘した。 [e008:f07] 「ハミルトンは契約上のナンバー1ドライバーであることに関心がない。 [e008:f08] これまで一度も気にしたことはなく、所属したどのチームでも契約上のナンバー1だったことはない」とクランシーは語った。 [e008:f09] 「対照的に、シャルル・ルクレールのようにナンバー1という地位そのものを望み、それを契約に盛り込ませたドライバーもいる」 「それを重視するドライバーもいれば、そうでないドライバーもいる。 [e008:f10] たいてい、最終的に複数回のワールドチャンピオンになるのは、そうしたことをあまり重視しないドライバーたちだ」 ルクレールの契約にナンバー1条項が存在するという指摘は、フェラーリ内部で緊張が高まっている現状を踏まえると興味深いものだ。 [e008:f11] ただし、現時点で契約の詳細や条項が適用される具体的な条件は明らかになっておらず、その存在についてもフェラーリから公式な確認は得られていない。 [e008:f12] クランシーによると、ハミルトンは契約上の特別な保証を求めるのではなく、コース上でのパフォーマンスとチーム内部での働きかけを通じて、自らの地位を確立することを好んできたという。 [e008:f13] 「ルイス・ハミルトンはこれまで、自分が所属したチームを常に掌握してきた。 [e008:f14] 彼はそこに加わり、そのチームを掌握した」 「そして今、フェラーリでも再び同じことをしているように見える」 この見解は、ハミルトンがフェラーリでの初年度の大半をチーム内部での自身のリーダーシップの確立に費やしたとする、元F1ワールドチャンピオンのジャック・ヴィルヌーヴの最近の発言とも重なる。 [e008:f15] 2026年シーズンを通じたハミルトンのパフォーマンス向上は、昨シーズンとは異なる力関係を生み出している。 [e008:f16] 契約上の保証の有無にかかわらず、ともにフェラーリの中心的存在となることを望む2人のドライバーをいかに管理するか。
